tagline: A simple booking page for Cassandra's cleaning business
painPoint: You said it yourself — first time dealing with a client who didn't pay after a full move-in deep clean, no answer on where the $485 went. This flips the order: clients pay when they book the clean, so there's nothing left to chase afterward.
demoSubtitle: Built for Cassandra — clients pay when they book, so a finished job never turns into an awkward chase for payment.
features: Payment collected upfront at booking, before the clean ever happens
No more wondering if a completed job will actually get paid for
One-time cost, no monthly subscription stacked on top
You still run the job the same way, just don't have to chase money anymore
